About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements such as Spanish).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

4. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

5. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

6. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

7. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.



Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, creator management, or media production.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows .
  • Proven experience working with creators, voice artists, or creative production teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

title: Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss?


Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look?


Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems?


Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?


If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role.


At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.


Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously.


This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent.


This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error.


However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Campaign Audit & Validation

  • Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, streaming platforms, and others
  • Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts
  • Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters


Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity

  • Identify discrepancies such as:
  • Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client
  • Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations
  • Inconsistent implementation across platforms
  • Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup


Budget & Pacing Verification

  • Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations
  • Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend
  • Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly


Tracking, Links & Technical QA

  • Verify accuracy and functionality of:
  • URLs and landing pages
  • UTM parameters and tracking links
  • Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable)
  • Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies


Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation

  • Compare campaign execution against:
  • Internal strategy direction
  • Client Success Manager requests
  • Campaign updates or pivots
  • Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely


Audit Documentation & Communication

  • Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence
  • Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error)
  • Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution


Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)


This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including:

Audit Cadence:

  • Pre-launch validation
  • Post-launch verification
  • Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits

Audit Coverage:

  • Full account audits
  • Targeted sampling across accounts

Audit Depth:

  • Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links)
  • Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)

Ownership Scope:

  • Identifying and flagging discrepancies
  • Recommending corrective actions
  • Supporting enforcement of quality standards


Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:

  • Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss
  • Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems
  • Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions
  • Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments
  • Have strong written communication skills
  • Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking)
  • Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification
  • Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools
  • Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)


Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce or CRM familiarity
  • Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors
  • Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards
  • Experience documenting processes or building SOPs
  • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment


Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Ads
  • Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • TikTok Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • TradeDesk


Why Our Work Matters:


Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough.


That’s where Crisp comes in.


We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.


Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably.


About Crisp:

Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022).


Crisp ( is the nation’s fastest-growing law firm growth company. We’ve helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue.

Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal.


OUR BOOK:

The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble)


OUR PODCAST:

The Game Changing Attorney Podcast


Why You Should Work Here:

  • You will work inside a structured, high-performance marketing operation
  • You will contribute to campaigns running at scale across hundreds of accounts
  • You will play a direct role in improving execution accuracy and system reliability
  • You will be trusted to identify and surface critical issues


This is not a role for someone looking for easy work or vague expectations.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in enforcing standards, identifying errors, and ensuring systems operate correctly.

  • Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, streaming platforms, and others
  • Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts
  • Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters


Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity

  • Identify discrepancies such as:
  • Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client
  • Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations
  • Inconsistent implementation across platforms
  • Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup


Budget & Pacing Verification

  • Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations
  • Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend
  • Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly


Tracking, Links & Technical QA

  • Verify accuracy and functionality of:
  • URLs and landing pages
  • UTM parameters and tracking links
  • Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable)
  • Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies


Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation

  • Compare campaign execution against:
  • Internal strategy direction
  • Client Success Manager requests
  • Campaign updates or pivots
  • Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely


Audit Documentation & Communication

  • Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence
  • Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error)
  • Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution


Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)


This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including:

Audit Cadence:

  • Pre-launch validation
  • Post-launch verification
  • Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits

Audit Coverage:

  • Full account audits
  • Targeted sampling across accounts

Audit Depth:

  • Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links)
  • Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)

Ownership Scope:

  • Identifying and flagging discrepancies
  • Recommending corrective actions
  • Supporting enforcement of quality standards


Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:

  • Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss
  • Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems
  • Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions
  • Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments
  • Have strong written communication skills
  • Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking)
  • Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification
  • Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools
  • Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)


Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce or CRM familiarity
  • Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors
  • Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards
  • Experience documenting processes or building SOPs
  • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment


Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):

Why Our Work Matters:


Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough.


That’s where Crisp comes in.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (LATAM Only)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (LATAM Only) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

Location: Remote — Brazil/US time zones (EST ±3h) • Contract: International contractor, $35/hour • Language: English (fluent) • Reports to: CTO, Engineering and Product team.



About the role

Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‑generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes.


Tech context

You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on:

  • Frontend: Next.js/React , Typescript , Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Node.js/TypeScript with a PostgreSQL core (schema design, authN,authZ, performance, transactions, triggers).
  • Data & integrations: Third-party API integrations ; performance profiling (e.g., Lighthouse).
  • Quality: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; CI/CD .
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, Product Designer, and CEO.


What you will do

  • Build and ship end‑to‑end features across the Next.js frontend and Node/TypeScript backend. 
  • Model and tune Postgres schemas; ensure secure authN/authZ and strong performance. 
  • Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‑driven improvements). 
  • Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows. 
  • Make pragmatic early‑stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar.


What you will bring

  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality. 
  • Strong production experience with Next.js/React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Tailwind & CSS mastery; responsive, accessible UI. 
  • PostgreSQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers). 
  • Integrations experience (third‑party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e). 
  • Portfolio or links to shipped projects/code.


90-day outcomes

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Lead at least one significant feature from design to production, used by real clinics or internal teams.​
  • Improve a key part of the frontend experience (e.g., performance, usability, or design consistency) and document the standards for others.​
  • Own part of the backend or data model, including at least one meaningful performance or reliability improvement.​
  • Help define or refine testing and deployment practices so the team can ship faster and with more confidence.


Nice to have

  • Experience building voice‑controlled components / speech‑to‑text. 
  • Experience interacting with AI models from the web app.


How we work

  • Remote within EST ±3 hours preferred ; open to other time zones if you can collaborate on US‑friendly hours.
  • Small, senior team with a strong bias toward action and ownership ;
  • Product-led culture : engineers are closely involved in discovery, tradeoff discussions, and shaping the roadmap.


Hiring process

  • Coderpad Challenge (60 min)
  • Intro chat (45 min) – mutual fit and role context.
  • Technical deep‑dive & Live testing – discuss systems you’ve built; pair on a focused problem (no whiteboard trivia).
  • Team conversation – meet engineering + product leadership.
  • References & offer.


Volatus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. AI Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.


The role:

They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.


This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.


What you’ll do:

  • Take prototypes to production. The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.
  • Own AI engineering decisions. Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.
  • Build full-stack. Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.
  • Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.
  • Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.
  • Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.
  • Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.
  • Work with AI agents. Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.


Tech you’ll work with:

  • Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React
  • Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.
  • AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.
  • Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0
  • You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.
  • Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD
  • CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.


What they’re looking for:

Must-haves

  • AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.
  • You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.
  • Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.
  • Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.
  • Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.
  • AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.
  • AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.
  • Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics
  • Snowflake / SQL analytics experience
  • Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX
  • Azure cloud platform experience
  • LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime


How our partner works:

Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.

  • Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.
  • Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.
  • Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.
  • Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cross-border logistics BD Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What You'll Do？

As BD Manager, you will own the full commercial cycle for UniUni's cross-border logistics business in your market (Brazil or Mexico):

  • Drive new business acquisition across cross-border e-commerce sellers, platforms, freight forwarders, and 3PL partners shipping into and out of LATAM.
  • Design and sell tailored end-to-end solutions covering first-mile pickup, international line-haul (air/sea), customs clearance, and last-mile delivery.
  • Build and scale a local partner network , including last-mile carriers, customs brokers, bonded warehouses, and fulfillment partners.
  • Own the full sales cycle — prospecting, solution design, pricing, contract negotiation, signing, onboarding, and payment collection.
  • Develop strategic accounts with high-volume cross-border sellers and platforms, positioning UniUni as their long-term logistics partner.
  • Provide market intelligence on competitors, pricing trends, customs/regulatory updates, and customer demand to inform global product strategy.
  • Represent UniUni at industry events, e-commerce conferences, and seller community gatherings.


What We're Looking For？

  • 6+ years of experience in B2B sales / business development within cross-border logistics, e-commerce fulfillment, last-mile delivery, or international freight forwarding .
  • Proven hunter mindset — track record of acquiring new enterprise / mid-market clients from zero and consistently exceeding revenue targets.
  • Deep understanding of the cross-border e-commerce ecosystem in Brazil and/or Mexico, including key sellers, marketplaces (Mercado Libre, Amazon, Shopee, Magalu, etc.), customs frameworks (e.g., Remessa Conforme in Brazil, IMMEX / Section 321 dynamics in Mexico), and last-mile landscape.
  • Strong existing network with cross-border sellers, freight forwarders, and last-mile partners in your market.
  • Commercial maturity — comfortable with pricing models, P&L conversations, and structured negotiation.
  • Fluent in Portuguese (Brazil) or Spanish (Mexico) AND English . Mandarin is a strong plus.
  • Self-starter, comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous, market-entry environment.
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent is a plus.

title: Médico Cardiologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Cardiologista em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO CARDIOLOGISTA (desejável RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Cardiologia . Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

Nosso time de profissionais desempenha um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em cardiologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios cardiológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em cardiologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças cardiológica s.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em cardiologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM CARDIOLOGIA, ou Especialização, residência concluída, ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Registro do Título de Especialista em cardiologia (RQE), emitido pelo Conselho Regional de Medicina do respectivo Estado ; ou matrícula em curso de residência, especialização, ou pós, em andamento;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em cardiologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com problemas de saúde cardiológicos .


Competências Comportamentais:

Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Cardiologia.

title: Business Analyst – Financial Crimes / Process Engineering
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst – Financial Crimes / Process Engineering em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Business Analyst – Financial Crimes / Process Engineering

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with strong experience in Financial Crimes and Process Engineering to support transformation initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with Compliance, Operations and Technology teams to map current processes, design future-state operating models, document requirements and support the implementation of improved, controlled and audit-ready processes.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with AML, KYC, Sanctions , process discovery, process mapping, AS-IS/TO-BE design, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, controls documentation and UAT support.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead workshops with Compliance, Operations and Technology stakeholders.
  • Map AS-IS processes and design TO-BE processes with focus on efficiency, control and regulatory alignment.
  • Gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements.
  • Create user stories, acceptance criteria, process rules and data rules.
  • Support backlog prioritization and dependency management.
  • Define KPIs, success measures and process improvement opportunities.
  • Support the design of controls and evidence required for audit and regulatory purposes.
  • Partner with data and technology teams to ensure data quality and accurate system integrations.
  • Support UAT, functional validation and go-live readiness.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, including process flows, SOPs, RACI and data lineage.
  • Facilitate alignment and decision-making between business and technology teams.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst .
  • At least 2+ years of experience in Financial Crimes , such as:
  • AML
  • KYC
  • Sanctions
  • Transaction monitoring
  • Compliance operations
  • Experience with process engineering , process discovery and process optimization.
  • Hands-on experience mapping AS-IS and TO-BE processes .
  • Experience with BPMN or similar process modeling notation.
  • Ability to write clear functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with controls, risk management, regulatory expectations and audit-ready documentation.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across Compliance, Operations and Technology.
  • Experience supporting UAT, testing and go-live readiness.
  • Experience with Agile delivery and tools such as Azure DevOps, TFS, Jira or Confluence.
  • Advanced English for interaction with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, banking, wealth management or consulting.
  • Six Sigma, Lean or process improvement certification.
  • Knowledge of data lineage, data quality and control frameworks.
  • Experience creating SOPs, RACI matrices and operational procedures.
  • Six Sigma Black Belt knowledge or certification.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is a Business Analyst with strong process improvement experience and real exposure to Financial Crimes . This is not a purely technical BA role and not a generic process analyst position. We are looking for someone who understands AML/KYC/Sanctions processes, can lead workshops, document requirements, map AS-IS/TO-BE processes, support UAT and help create controlled, audit-ready documentation.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software III
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software III em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a fintech do Grupo Energisa, que há mais de 120 anos leva energia de qualidade a milhões de brasileiros e impulsiona o desenvolvimento do país. Aqui na Voltz, nosso propósito é acelerar a inclusão digital e financeira de clientes em todo o Brasil.

Desde 2021, construímos soluções inovadoras que atendem todo o ecossistema do Grupo Energisa, empresa, clientes e fornecedores . Atuamos como um hub de produtos financeiros escaláveis, geradores de valor e focados em transformar a experiência de quem utiliza serviços essenciais.

Estamos em constante evolução e buscamos pessoas que queiram construir o futuro com a gente, com inovação, tecnologia, impacto real e foco no cliente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Ser o owner técnico de um domínio ou subsistema, garantindo evolução segura e saudável ao longo do tempo.
  • Garantir que o domínio opere com SLOs acordados (latência/erros/disponibilidade) e trabalhar ativamente para melhorar a confiabilidade.
  • Liderar planejamento técnico e execução do domínio: decomposição, dependências, riscos, execução e validação.
  • Elevar consistentemente o nível técnico do time: boas práticas, revisão forte, referências, documentação e padrões.
  • Ser referência técnica interna: apoiar decisões complexas, destravar discussões e reduzir retrabalho.
  • Liderar resposta a incidentes do seu domínio: mitigação, RCA rigoroso e ações preventivas estruturais.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • TypeScript + Node.js (async/await, promises, error handling; event loop, streams e concorrência).
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com OpenAPI (contratos, validação e status codes).
  • SQL (Postgres): consultas, migrations, otimização de queries e índices.
  • Git e fluxo de PRs (commits pequenos, rebase e resolução simples de conflitos).
  • Testes automatizados (unitários, integração e contrato) com Jest.
  • CI/CD e deploy: pipeline (lint/test/build/deploy), smoke tests, variáveis e logs.
  • Observabilidade: logs estruturados, métricas básicas e tracing superficial.
  • Mensageria e resiliência (BullMQ/RabbitMQ): retry, DLQ, idempotência e ordering quando necessário.

title: Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss?


Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look?


Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems?


Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?


If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role.


At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.


Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously.


This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent.


This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error.


However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Campaign Audit & Validation

  • Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, streaming platforms, and others
  • Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts
  • Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters


Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity

  • Identify discrepancies such as:
  • Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client
  • Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations
  • Inconsistent implementation across platforms
  • Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup


Budget & Pacing Verification

  • Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations
  • Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend
  • Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly


Tracking, Links & Technical QA

  • Verify accuracy and functionality of:
  • URLs and landing pages
  • UTM parameters and tracking links
  • Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable)
  • Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies


Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation

  • Compare campaign execution against:
  • Internal strategy direction
  • Client Success Manager requests
  • Campaign updates or pivots
  • Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely


Audit Documentation & Communication

  • Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence
  • Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error)
  • Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution


Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)


This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including:

Audit Cadence:

  • Pre-launch validation
  • Post-launch verification
  • Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits

Audit Coverage:

  • Full account audits
  • Targeted sampling across accounts

Audit Depth:

  • Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links)
  • Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)

Ownership Scope:

  • Identifying and flagging discrepancies
  • Recommending corrective actions
  • Supporting enforcement of quality standards


Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:

  • Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss
  • Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems
  • Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions
  • Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments
  • Have strong written communication skills
  • Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking)
  • Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification
  • Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools
  • Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)


Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce or CRM familiarity
  • Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors
  • Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards
  • Experience documenting processes or building SOPs
  • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment


Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Ads
  • Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • TikTok Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • TradeDesk


Why Our Work Matters:


Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough.


That’s where Crisp comes in.


We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.


Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably.


About Crisp:

Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022).


Crisp ( is the nation’s fastest-growing law firm growth company. We’ve helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue.

Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal.


OUR BOOK:

The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble)


OUR PODCAST:

The Game Changing Attorney Podcast


Why You Should Work Here:

  • You will work inside a structured, high-performance marketing operation
  • You will contribute to campaigns running at scale across hundreds of accounts
  • You will play a direct role in improving execution accuracy and system reliability
  • You will be trusted to identify and surface critical issues


This is not a role for someone looking for easy work or vague expectations.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in enforcing standards, identifying errors, and ensuring systems operate correctly.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.

This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent.


This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error.


However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

Key Responsibilities Include:


Campaign Audit & Validation

  • Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, streaming platforms, and others
  • Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts
  • Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters


Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity

  • Identify discrepancies such as:
  • Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client
  • Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations
  • Inconsistent implementation across platforms
  • Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup


Budget & Pacing Verification

  • Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations
  • Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend
  • Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly


Tracking, Links & Technical QA

  • Verify accuracy and functionality of:
  • URLs and landing pages
  • UTM parameters and tracking links
  • Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable)
  • Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies


Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation

  • Compare campaign execution against:
  • Internal strategy direction
  • Client Success Manager requests
  • Campaign updates or pivots
  • Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely


Audit Documentation & Communication

  • Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence
  • Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error)
  • Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution


Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)


This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including:

Audit Cadence:

  • Pre-launch validation
  • Post-launch verification
  • Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits

Audit Coverage:

  • Full account audits
  • Targeted sampling across accounts

Audit Depth:

  • Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links)
  • Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)

Ownership Scope:

  • Identifying and flagging discrepancies
  • Recommending corrective actions
  • Supporting enforcement of quality standards


Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:

  • Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss
  • Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems
  • Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions
  • Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments
  • Have strong written communication skills
  • Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking)
  • Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification
  • Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools
  • Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)


Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce or CRM familiarity
  • Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors
  • Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards
  • Experience documenting processes or building SOPs

Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):

Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough.


That’s where Crisp comes in.


We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.

Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‑generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes.


Tech context

You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on:

  • Frontend: Next.js/React , Typescript , Tailwind CSS

  • Quality: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; CI/CD .

What you will do

  • Build and ship end‑to‑end features across the Next.js frontend and Node/TypeScript backend. 
  • Model and tune Postgres schemas; ensure secure authN/authZ and strong performance. 
  • Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‑driven improvements). 
  • Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows. 
  • Make pragmatic early‑stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar.


What you will bring

  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality. 
  • Strong production experience with Next.js/React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Tailwind & CSS mastery; responsive, accessible UI. 
  • PostgreSQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers). 
  • Integrations experience (third‑party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e).

90-day outcomes

  • Help define or refine testing and deployment practices so the team can ship faster and with more confidence.


Nice to have

  • Experience interacting with AI models from the web app.


How we work

  • Remote within EST ±3 hours preferred ; open to other time zones if you can collaborate on US‑friendly hours.

Hiring process

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech

startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential

through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with

founders to deliver high-impact design solutions — from MVP design sprints to full-scale product

interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We're looking for a relentless, resourceful hunter who doesn't wait for leads to come to them.

You won't inherit a playbook — you'll write one. If you've built pipeline from scratch, found

decision-makers nobody handed you, and converted cold conversations into real opportunities,

this role is for you. Comfortable with ambiguity, energized by the chase, and sharp enough to

earn a founder's attention in three sentences or less.


You'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers — primarily

founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies. You'll play a critical role in

connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

• Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems

• Source qualified leads independently using any channel that works — LinkedIn,

communities, events, cold email, social, referrals, or whatever creative approach you

invent. No channel is off-limits.

• Own the full top-of-funnel — from identifying a name to booking a call — without relying

on inbound or handed leads.

• Develop and test your own outreach experiments; own the results and iterate fast.

• Find creative angles to reach founders — conference attendee lists, community posts,

funding announcements, product launches — and turn them into booked conversations.

• Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities

• Track activities and performance using CRM tools

• Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in

SaaS or agency environments)

• Proven ability to book meetings with cold prospects — share examples of creative

outreach that worked

• Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach

• A track record of sourcing your own leads, not just working a provided list

• Comfortable operating without a defined system — you build your own process, manage

your own time, and hold yourself accountable to results

• Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)

• Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely

• English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

• Experience selling design, product, or digital services

• Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development

• Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work to identify high-impact projects at fast-growing SaaS and tech

companies, helping shape the digital tools that empower businesses worldwide. Your

contributions will be significant in driving growth for the business, with outcomes of your efforts

making a clear impact. This is an opportunity to take the step in your career in a studio that

values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


This is not a role with rigid scripts or assigned lead lists. You'll have full creative freedom to find

and engage the right clients in whatever way works — we care only about results. If you've ever

felt constrained by a playbook, you’ll love working at Foundey.

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Duotalk

A Duotalk é uma plataforma omnichannel com inteligência artificial que transforma o atendimento em conversas eficientes, escaláveis e orientadas a resultado.

Estamos construindo um produto complexo, com alta integração e impacto direto no negócio dos clientes e precisamos de pessoas que garantam qualidade real na entrega, não só organização.


Missão do cargo

Garantir que estamos construindo certo o produto, com clareza, qualidade e zero ambiguidade, atuando desde a definição até a validação final das entregas.

Você será responsável por transformar estratégia em entrega funcional, testada e confiável.


Atividades:

  • Gerenciar o backlog de produtos ou de squads complexas, atuando como um especialista.
  • Colaborar diretamente com o Product Manager na definição e refinamento da estratégia de produto.
  • Definir e comunicar as prioridades estratégicas para o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Liderar as cerimônias ágeis, garantindo que o time esteja sempre alinhado e produtivo.
  • Mentorar outros Product Owners e analistas em técnicas de gestão de backlog.
  • Conduzir o refinamento de requisitos complexos, desdobrando a visão do produto em entregas incrementais.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para dúvidas e decisões sobre o escopo do produto.
  • Acompanhar de perto as métricas de produto para validar o impacto das entregas e propor otimizações.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas junnto com o time de desenvolvimento.
  • Realizar testes funcionais das entregas antes de produção.
  • Validar fluxos completos (não só partes isoladas).
  • Trabalhar junto com devs na validação do que foi desenvolvido.
  • Identificar inconsistências, edge cases e falhas de lógica.
  • Garantir que os critérios de aceite foram de fato atendidos.
  • Atuar como último gate de qualidade antes do release.


Hard Skills:

  • Expertise em Metodologias Ágeis e Escala: SAFe, LeSS ou outros frameworks (diferencial).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas de Gestão de Produtos: Jira, Confluence, Productboard (uso avançado).
  • Conhecimento Aprofundado em UX Research e Análise de Dados de Produto: Para embasar decisões.
  • Habilidade de prototipação (Diferencial): Para agilizar o alinhamento de ideias.
  • Noções de Arquitetura de Software: Para entender os impactos das decisões no desenvolvimento.


Soft Skills:

  • Visão Estratégica e de Negócios: Consegue conectar cada item do backlog à estratégia maior da Duotalk.
  • Liderança (sem ser gerente): Guia o time de desenvolvimento, influenciando e inspirando.
  • Habilidade de Negociação Avançada: Para balancear as necessidades de diferentes stakeholders.
  • Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Aborda dilemas de priorização e escopo com maestria.
  • Capacidade Analítica Avançada: Para usar dados e tomar decisões sobre o backlog.
  • Proatividade para Inovação: Busca novas formas de entregar valor e otimizar processos


O que oferecemos:

  • Contratação PJ;
  • 100% remoto;
  • Possibilidade de crescimento;
  • Gympass
  • Conexa Saúde
  • Optum Consultoria
  • Alura Educação

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. AI Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.


The role:

They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.


This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.


What you’ll do:

  • Take prototypes to production. The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.
  • Own AI engineering decisions. Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.
  • Build full-stack. Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.
  • Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.
  • Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.
  • Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.
  • Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.
  • Work with AI agents. Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.


Tech you’ll work with:

  • Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React
  • Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.
  • AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.
  • Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0
  • You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.
  • Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD
  • CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.


What they’re looking for:

Must-haves

  • AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.
  • You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.
  • Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.
  • Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.
  • Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.
  • AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.
  • AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.
  • Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics
  • Snowflake / SQL analytics experience
  • Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX
  • Azure cloud platform experience
  • LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime


How our partner works:

Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.

  • Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.
  • Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.
  • Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.
  • Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Senior Java Backend Engineer / Service Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Java Backend Engineer to join a global technology team and work on the development, enhancement, and support of scalable back-end services and APIs.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, relational databases, CI/CD, and production-grade service development .   • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in enterprise applications.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and CI/CD processes.
  • Work with global teams in English.

  • Strong experience with Java 8+ , preferably Java 17 .
  • Solid experience with Spring Framework / Spring Boot .
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs .
  • Good understanding of object-oriented programming and clean code principles .
  • Experience with microservices and distributed applications.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar .
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance services.

Nice to have

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.
